deduplication: Historical DELETE-mode ledger, writer-contention and COMMIT-BUSY fixtures did not cover a reader retaining an old WAL snapshot after another connection commits. New work is a bounded supplement to the existing economy article, not a replacement or rerun of those historical experiments.
protocol_scope: One thread, one file, predetermined calls on two overlapping connections in WAL. Two attempted upgrades within each invocation are the same stale-snapshot condition. Normal close/reopen is not crash recovery or power-loss durability.
copyright: Original explanation and small purpose-written fixture; no copied documentation bulk or third-party source archive.
